meta.source: MPLADS eSAKSHI portal (mplads.mospi.gov.in), Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
meta.joined_to: Lok Sabha 2024 winners by state + constituency
caveats: eSAKSHI tracks the revised MPLADS procedure from 1 April 2023 onward; figures cover the current term only and its 'allocated limit' includes balances carried forward from a seat's previous MP - it is not the full-term entitlement.
The portal is live; these numbers are a dated snapshot and will differ from the portal on any later day.
MPs only RECOMMEND works. Funds go to district authorities, who sanction and execute - low expenditure is not by itself MP inaction, and early-term percentages are structurally low.
Lok Sabha MPs only; Rajya Sabha MPLADS entitlements are excluded, so totals here will not match scheme-wide figures.

Rows are joined to election data by constituency name; 97.8% matched. The two sources transliterate names differently, so 19 seats were matched approximately and 12 duplicate rows were dropped. Every approximate match, every unmatched seat, and every seat whose sitting MP differs from the 2024 winner is listed below rather than hidden.

comparisons.note: Agreement here is the strongest signal that both readings of the official portal are sound.
Small gaps are expected: the portal is live and the two snapshots were taken at different moments.
Counts may be scoped differently by term.
Large gaps here indicate a definitional difference, not an error - the portal's own tile counts recommendations differently from a per-MP sum. Do not read this as one source being wrong.
